gates.name: Dependency audit
gates.notes: Policy and deny configuration exist; final advisory evidence must be produced by release CI.

gates.name: License audit
gates.notes: Final license report is not embedded in this repository evidence bundle.

gates.name: Secret scan
gates.notes: Final scan must be run by release CI from the release candidate.

gates.name: SBOM
gates.notes: SBOM is not generated in this bundle.

gates.name: Signature status
gates.notes: Cryptographic artifact signing is not implemented; no signing claim is made.

gates.name: Redaction gate
gates.target: runtime diagnostics, CLI observations, and release reports
gates.notes: Redaction tests pass locally and release reports carry redacted summaries only.

gates.name: Native-handle boundary
gates.target: runtime public API, diagnostics, observations, and release reports
gates.notes: No raw Provider, Device, Kernel, tensor, memory, KV-cache, or model-weight handles are exposed in release evidence.

gates.name: Component Artifact trust boundary
gates.notes: Component Artifact trust tests enforce fail-closed behavior for unsigned production artifacts unless explicit local development policy allows them.

gates.name: Model Artifact trust boundary
gates.target: Model Artifact trust and integrity validation
gates.notes: Model Artifact trust tests reject untrusted or self-asserted source metadata before loading.

gates.name: Source cache trust boundary
gates.notes: Source-cache policy tests ensure cache hits, aliases, local files, and fixture status do not imply trust.

gates.name: CLI authority not delegated
gates.target: CLI boundary and Runtime request surface
gates.notes: CLI boundary tests keep filesystem, Git, network, secret, shell, tool, and agent authority in the CLI process.

gates.name: Runtime Inference API security
gates.notes: Runtime Inference API tests reject non-inference authority and require Runtime-owned generation execution evidence before sampling logits.

gates.name: Unsafe-code review
gates.notes: Unsafe-code policy is covered by executable tests.

gates.name: Lockfile integrity
gates.notes: Cargo.lock is committed in the PR branch and covered by cargo check, clippy, tests, and cargo-deny policy.

gates.name: Dependency feature review
gates.notes: Dependency feature review policy is documented; final release CI must attach expanded dependency feature evidence before stable publication.

gates.name: Vulnerability handling policy
gates.target: release security notes and advisory exceptions
gates.notes: Security exceptions include owner, severity, rationale, mitigation, follow-up, and release-note linkage.

gates.name: Security notes
gates.notes: Release statement and security report describe supported scope, unsupported features, limitations, known risks, and reporting follow-ups.

gates.name: Artifact integrity
gates.notes: Checksums are provided for this evidence bundle in checksums.sha256.

security_exceptions.rationale: The repository evidence bundle documents v0.1 release readiness but does not produce final distribution artifacts.
security_exceptions.mitigation: No SBOM claim is made for v0.1 repository evidence; release CI must generate and attach an SBOM before a distributable release is published.
security_exceptions.follow_up: Generate SBOM from the release candidate build in release CI.

security_exceptions.rationale: Cryptographic artifact signing is not implemented by this repository evidence bundle.
security_exceptions.mitigation: The bundle publishes checksums only and explicitly avoids making any signature claim.
security_exceptions.follow_up: Add artifact signing to the release pipeline before publishing signed binary artifacts.

security_exceptions.rationale: The repository evidence bundle cannot embed final CI advisory, license, and secret-scan reports before the release candidate workflow completes.
security_exceptions.mitigation: Security-report gates are marked as documented limitations and must be replaced or supplemented by final CI-produced reports at release cutover.
security_exceptions.follow_up: Attach final advisory, license, and secret-scan outputs from release CI.
